The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and your payoff is your value minus the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction even when the prize is worth more than the second-highest bid. Bidding more than your value risks winning the auction and paying more than the prize is worth. Therefore, I will bid my value of $40.
